header: L9 · The delivery manager who has seen hundred-task plans · sonnet
verdict: Prior findings resolved (4 of 4 with status A); the delta changed the spec but not the plan, which now trails it in two tasks (T090, T005).

findings.defect: The round-9 write pass made --pre-tag run six checks (the two of 11 11.4 added) and added step 7, acceptance --tags, but T090 still says the pre-tag run does 'the four checks' and no task builds or tests --tags.
findings.scenario: T090 is built from its acceptance lines: --pre-tag gets four checks, passes the O7 run on a candidate with a default-overturned result, and the tag ships; step 7 at the first release after v1.0.0 finds a flag nobody built.
findings.change: In T090 say --pre-tag runs the six repository-only checks and add a --tags acceptance line (a fixture: tag commit equal to the attested source digest, and a moved tag failing); or park --tags as a post-v1 task.

findings.section: plan.md T005 (tools/ci pr) and T002; 10 10.2 (pr job row); 12 12.4
findings.defect: The G5 fix made pr a pull_request_target job running the default branch's code, with its own workflows grammar row, git flag rules and a checkout rule; T005 (which 'lands whole') and T002 carry no acceptance line for the pr workflow file, its fixtures, or the git hardening, and plan.md never mentions pull_request_target.
findings.scenario: T005 passes on its listed fixtures and merges a pr step with no workflow file or a pull_request-triggered one; the grammar row has no task, so tools/ci workflows lacks the fixtures that refuse a head checkout, and the control meant to stop a PR from judging itself is never built.
findings.change: Add to T005 the pr.yml workflow, one workflows fixture per admitted and refused case of the pr job row, a fixture per git flag rule, and say that the pr job joins the required checks when T005 lands; note the PR that adds the file is judged by no pr job.

findings.section: plan.md, Operator blocks, list of tooling pull requests outside the task list
findings.defect: The list stops at round 8 and is not extended by round 9 and the 2026-10-09 decisions: it has no entry for the approvals surface in .github/ask-first.yaml, the tools/ci pr base-defined job, or ADR 0010's reopened required-checks item, and the new sbxdrv dependencies in T015 and T078 point at an unnumbered 'surface tooling PR' that only this list identifies.
findings.scenario: Planning the tooling PRs, the maintainer finds the list does not name the changes the delta added, and T015 waits on a PR with no id or owner.
findings.change: Extend the list with the approvals surface and the pr job, give the sbxdrv/kits surface PR a label that T015 and T078 cite, and record the required-checks decision as an item of the next decision block.

pages_read: docs/plan.md delta, T005, T015, T078, T090, tooling PR list
out_of_scope: R9-5 (parked for stage B); token-narrowing review due (open for the operator); ADR 0010 required-checks decision (open); whether the pull_request_target behaviour matches GitHub in practice.
confidence: Medium-high: each cited line was read at the baseline; no workflow was run.
